title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Charge Slab Lengths
content:
Chargeable days under the Demurrage and Detention Free Time products are priced on an escalating scale of four slabs. This card gives the length of the first three slabs for each product; the fourth slab has no length, because it takes every chargeable day left over once the first three are used up.

## Lengths

Slab 1 holds the opening chargeable days, slab 2 the days that come after slab 1, and slab 3 the days that come after slab 2. All lengths are whole days.

| Product | Slab 1 length | Slab 2 length | Slab 3 length |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Tariff Free Time | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 3 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| AHL Free Time Extension 7 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 14 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| AHL Combined Free Time 21 | 5 | 5 | 10 |
| AHL Contract Free Time 30 | 7 | 7 | 14 |

## Position bands that follow from the lengths

Counting chargeable days by their position on the slab scale, the lengths above give these bands:

| Band | Tariff, extension and combined products | AHL Contract Free Time 30 |
|---|---|---|
| Slab 1 | positions 1 to 5 | positions 1 to 7 |
| Slab 2 | positions 6 to 10 | positions 8 to 14 |
| Slab 3 | positions 11 to 20 | positions 15 to 28 |
| Slab 4 | position 21 onward | position 29 onward |

Hypothetical check: a day in position 20 is still in slab 3 on the tariff scale, because 5 plus 5 plus 10 comes to 20; the next position moves into slab 4. On the contract scale the same position 20 lies in slab 3, whose last position is 28.
